summary: The contract is one fixed-width scalar decision, so the unavoidable constant output work matches the constant-time divisibility test and no genuine scalable slower principal class exists.

optimality.argument: Any correct implementation must produce one boolean answer. Testing whether the scalar is zero or divisible by ten uses a fixed number of operations independent of its magnitude.

replacement_checks.evidence: Producing the required boolean for the fixed-arity query requires at least one operation.
The reference performs one zero comparison, at most one remainder operation, and one comparison.
Regression exhaustively compares all 1000001 legal inputs with an independent arithmetic digit-reversal oracle.
